packages.name: kaireader
packages.title: KaiReader
packages.author: Mizuiro
packages.description: Book reader for Switch 2: your DRM-free EPUB, PDF, comics (CBZ, CBR, CB7), FB2, MOBI and TXT with their covers, from the SD card, a network folder (SMB, WebDAV, FTP, SFTP) or your book server (Calibre-Web, Kavita, Komga), and free classics from Project Gutenberg and Standard Ebooks. Ten text sizes, four page colors, two pages side by side, zoom, bookmarks and the console held upright like a book.
